Some reactions of chromium ions are shown below.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Use the Data Booklet to suggest a suitable metal to carry out reaction 1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Use $E^\ominus$ values to explain your answer to (i) by calculating the $E^\ominus_{\text{cell}}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A student suggested that reaction 2 could be carried out using acidified hydrogen peroxide solution.

Use the Data Booklet to show whether or not this reaction is feasible.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain using oxidation numbers whether or not reaction 3 is a redox reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
The student used an acidified solution of $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}\text{(aq)}$ to electroplate a steel box with chromium metal.

Calculate how long it would take for a current of 0.125A to deposit 0.0312g of chromium metal.
